prs.title: Draft PR012+013: bounded repository history and delta pages
prs.body_as_observed:
## Combined ROADMAP-PR-012+013 — implementation stage

This draft adds scoped, keyset-paged repository snapshot history and path deltas to the canonical Content Lab SQLite owner. Native exposes `durable.repo.history` and `durable.repo.delta` with explicit EOF; Desktop validates their DTOs and atomically exports complete JSONL and SHA-256 receipts. A 1–50 row frame is not a corpus ceiling. Delta requires complete pinned snapshots and supports an explicit historical `baseSnapshotId`; continuation binds the exact head/base pair.

The branch integrates main's PR-006 and PR-007; the Windows installer carries both `repo_groups.py` and `repo_history.py`. With explicit `desktop_scan_enabled: true` in the operator profile, Desktop controls the existing `repo_scan_runs` ledger if its schema is ready: START, STATUS, STEP, PAUSE, CONTINUE, CANCEL, with revision/cursor fencing. This is manual page stepping and a recoverable committed cursor, not a background scheduler. The default Desktop gate remains read-only.

Local verification: `test_repo_history` 4 passed (26 snapshots, 25 delta paths, historical base, incomplete head/base, Unicode cursors), Desktop transport/integration 29 passed, package verification passed. One Tk/display test is skipped locally; Windows CI covers it. Exact-head CI for the previous history stage passed on Ubuntu and Windows in [run 37208580756](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/actions/runs/37208580756). Current head `8f65e6fee659335aae2ebcdd29598fe18cd14d63` passed Ubuntu CI; Windows is running in [run 37211060798](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/actions/runs/37211060798). Installed Dell/Windows qualification remains pending. See `docs/automation/roadmap-pr012-013-progress.md`.

**Combined ZIP still open.** WS-002 Core background job integration, WS-003 remaining selection/export consumers and legacy summary memory, WS-006 derived CAS/invalidation, and WS-009/010/011 document/media/web importers remain unimplemented. PR-010/011 contracts have not yet landed. Draft #50 changes the same Desktop and Native files and will need integration when ready. Do not merge this draft as package completion.

prs.title: Draft PR012+013 continuation: immutable source originals
prs.body_as_observed:
## PR-012+013 continuation: immutable local original ledger

The merged #47 supplied complete paged repository history and opt-in Desktop scan controls. This continuation adds an additive Source/Version/Observation ledger for explicitly selected local FILE and MEDIA originals in the same Content Lab SQLite database.

- Raw bytes are staged in 64 KiB parts keyed by namespace and exact SHA-256. Two origins with identical bytes share one object; a changed origin creates a new version. Observations have independent intent keys.
- An interrupted capture never publishes a version/head. Replay verifies staged bytes and resumes; a second full hash and file fingerprint gate publication. Read APIs page versions, part metadata and fixed-size byte delta ranges to EOF, with per-part hash verification; this is not a semantic diff.
- The branch incorporates merged PR018/019 and the Windows installer includes both its workflow modules and this new module. A standalone isolated-Python CLI provides capture without browser grants or implicit network access.
- Nine local tests pass: identity/reuse, stable key across path rename, 23-version continuation, interrupted stage, drift/corruption, additive migration, pair-bound byte delta continuation across 51 parts, and installed-style CLI. Ubuntu CI passed on the previous head. Windows exposed a false SOURCE_DRIFT after file rewrites; head `3f8c87f677c238a27d409496963856f167fc490d` changes the Windows check to exact two-pass bytes plus file identity. Exact-head CI is [running](https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/actions/runs/37215650102); installed Windows device qualification is pending.

Design and limits: `docs/automation/pr012-013-source-ledger.md`. This is a substrate, **not completion of the combined 101 criteria**. Existing ChatGPT import uses its own specialized raw table; unified CAS reconciliation, parser/extraction cache, selective evidence invalidation, PDF/Office/OCR, media/ASR, web/RSS/GitHub adapters, Core background jobs and full scale/device receipts remain open. Keep this PR draft until its scoped stage is validated; do not present #47 or this continuation as the full roadmap.
